funding_caller.proposed_property: Any new funding initiated along this caller requires a non-forward payment, known height, expiry at least two blocks later, and the registered incoming amount equal to request.incoming_amount_msat. A contract/fee amount relation requires a separate proved registration invariant.
funding_caller.first_blocker: The caller first awaits get_registered_incoming_contract_and_client_v2: an async persistent lookup keyed by PaymentImage::Hash. Its result and amount equality depend on database state; the readonly helper model supplies neither that state nor an async/effect specification.
